    Stable translation quivers #

    For a stable translation quiver (every vertex nonprojective and noninjective, TranslationQuiver.IsStable) the translation is a permutation τ of the vertices. The mate bijections give y → x iff τ x → y, and τ preserves arrows. These facts are used throughout the proof of Proposition 4.1 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex).
